msg: There are two baskets: red and yellow. If you select the red, purple, brown or pink gnome, the red basket will be chosen. In the alternative, if the yellow, orange, blue and green gnome is selected, the yellow basket will be chosen. One of the baskets (i.e. red or yellow) will provide more mushrooms for a period of time. Therefore, it is important to work out which basket is giving more mushrooms, and to keep selecting the relevant gnome for the correct basket to be chosen until the supply of mushrooms runs very low. It is then advisable to then switch to the other basket. The supply will keep switching throughout the game.
